verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation that Flagsmith's server SDKs evaluate flags in-process from a cached ruleset. The Edge Proxy is a self-hosted service that server SDKs still call over the network, so it is an adjacent feature rather than per-check local evaluation. The CLI's 'evaluate flags the way an SDK would' says nothing about SDK-side local evaluation, and one community comment speculates that Flagsmith 'apparently' does mainly server-side evaluation.
